item.title: BMW driver who opted for trial after running red light with camera found guilty
item.description: Gregory Keniston, of Drillfield Road, ignored the signal on the A556, Chester Road, at the junction with Dalefords Lane, on Monday, May 19, while heading in the direction of Chester.

item.title: RE teacher helps shape future of lessons on religious freedom in schools nationwide
item.description: Scarlett Hayward, director of learning for religious studies at Hartford Church of England High School, is one eight teachers from across the UK commissioned to review teaching resources for lessons on freedom of religion by the Freedom Declared Foundation (FDF).

item.title: Swan deaths after ‘large diesel spill’ on Trent & Mersey Canal put down to bird flu
item.description: The suspected diesel spill, reported to the Canal & River Trust on Monday, November 24, is believed to have affected a four-mile stretch of the canal between the Anderton Boat Lift and the Broken Cross area.

item.title: 'Kick in the teeth': Roberts Bakery starts hiring weeks after mass redundancies
item.description: Roberts Bakery bread plant in Rudheath, now owned by Boparan Private Office, is taking on staff after 86 workers were made redundant by the administrators of its previous owner, Frank Roberts & Sons, on October 14.

item.title: WATCH: Police had to crash into dangerous driver after M6 and M62 pursuit
item.description: SHOCKING video footage has been released showing a dangerous driver trying to head the wrong way down the M62 during a police chase.

item.title: Fears raised as chiefs back homes on 'grey belt' farmland
item.description: A similar scheme had been thrown out in August due to it being on protected green belt land.

item.title: Inquest opened into death of woman who 'fell from height' on the M6
item.description: AN inquest has been opened into the death of a woman who ‘fell from height’ on the M6.

item.title: Drivers warned of disruption as abnormal load 'convoy' takes in towns on way to docks
item.description: An special highways order has been granted by Cheshire West and Chester Council for a convoy to travel through the borough between midnight on Sunday, December 7, and 23.59pm on Monday, December 8.

item.title: Police close road after three-car smash at A54 crossroads in rush hour
item.description: Cheshire Police closed the A54 in between Middlewich and Winsford for about one-and-a-half hours.

item.title: Brain cancer sufferer who ran length of India in 74 days honoured by football club
item.description: Jack Faint from Northwich completed his epic endurance challenge, Project India 4,000, on around Tuesday, November 11.
